name: @chernabog/recipes
description: Chernabog's recipes: complete flows a repo copies in, or imports, written from @chernabog/sdk

implement.description: Implements the oldest auto:eligible or auto:ship issue unattended, and asks a reviewer from the pool once its pull request is green

review.description: Reviews a pull request whose review is requested of the persona; an approval merges an auto:ship pull request

re-review.description: Reviews again when asked, in its own review session; approves, or hands the pull request to a person

address-review.description: Answers a review that requests changes on the persona's own pull request, in the session that wrote it

resolve-conflicts.description: Merges the base into the persona's own pull request when it conflicts, resolves the conflicts, and asks an approving reviewer to look again

plan.description: Turns an auto:plan spec issue into an epic of sub-issues, linked by what blocks what, once a person approves the agent's plan

epic.description: Works through an auto:epic issue's tasks as pull requests, each stacked on the branch of the task it builds on, and parks between changes to its layers

human-initiated.description: The hybrid path: chernabog start <issue> opens a session with a person, then opens the pull request and asks for a review
